About this space
The Buffalo Place offers a unique and comfortable stay for travellers and also a cozy and welcoming atmosphere for guests.
The accommodation is equipped with modern amenities to ensure a convenient stay, including comfortable beds, private bathrooms, and essential facilities.
We offer various amenities, these may include complimentary Wi-Fi access, a communal lounge area, a fully equipped kitchen for self-catering, and a friendly and attentive staff to assist you with any needs or inquiries.

Other things to note
We have security onsite from 6pm to 6am. We have safeguards rapid response whereby if the alarm goes off or a guest presses the panic button they respond onsite within five minutes.
